note: Every band, weight, floor, sample count and tolerance of the tree grader (cad_tree.convert, cad_tree.grade). Bands are [full, zero]: 1 at |error| <= full, 0 at >= zero, linear between. Lengths mm, angles deg where a key says so, else rad. Starting values from robotic_arm_cad_design_from_photos (design_rules.yaml, grader_config.json, 2026-10-21 floors).

gates.note: unit gates multiply the design score; arm gates multiply that arm's criteria only (an arm whose joints disagree with its motors scores 0, the other arm is still scored). Put cad_json_consistent under unit to make it unit-wide.

key_lengths.note: per arm, from the joint axes at configuration Z (both units by the same rule): anchor = the driving motor's output-face centre projected on the joint axis; centre = the point nearest the listed axes (the shoulder centre J1 x J2 and the wrist centre J6 x J7 of the generator's key_quantities); distances point-point, point-line or line-line by the entity kinds

operating_box.note: the box is the reference's tree-joint limits (unit.json), else gt.json operating_box_rad, else this provisional box (said so in the output)
operating_box.finger: the finger joints' own limits in unit.json (0 .. the module's open stop)

tolerances.case_side_note: strict: a motor whose case rides on the other side of its joint than the unit's invalidates the arm; reported: it is reported, and the joint's sense is taken from the side the case rides on (cad_tree.convert).
tolerances.link_membership_note: strict: a link is the reference link with the same tag set, a part fixed to another link invalidates the arm; majority: the rigid link holding the largest share of the reference link's part volume, a part fixed elsewhere is graded where it is and reported (cad_tree.convert).

interference.note: which draws count: config = the reference unit has no colliding pair at the draw (the brief's rule); pair = every draw, the pairs that collide in the reference left out (more draws when the box's joint combinations often collide)

clearances.note: overlap volume over the smaller link's volume; 1 at <= ratio, 0 at >= 10 x ratio, log-linear between (score_ratio); adjacent = joined by any joint, loop joints included

fit.note: per motor: keep-out x case side x output side. Keep-out: the volume of the made parts of the case link and the driven link inside the class keep-out beyond the reference's own, over the class volume (score_ratio). Each side: rings 1 mm outboard of the mounting faces / the output face, at the bolt circle radius -+ (bolt d / 2 + margin); a ring counts when the reference's own parts fill at least ref_min_fraction of it; score = ring_score(f_sub / f_ref) over the counted rings (a side with none counted is not scored)

part_alignment.note: per part: restricted point-to-plane ICP from the identity (n_src samples of the submitted part against max(n_dst, n_dst_per_mm2 x area) of the reference part, capped at n_dst_max, trimmed, total correction within max_t_mm / max_r_deg); above multistart_rms_mm the 24 principal-axis starts

probes.note: cad_tree.features: the cut-out section raster, its search window and presence threshold; the spacer rays (start behind the output face, circles across the ring or the disc, angles per circle)

torso_alignment.note: the submitted torso (made parts, column, J1 motors) onto the reference's: the column frames matched, then point-to-plane ICP; the 24 principal-axis starts when the trimmed RMS exceeds 3 mm; last a point-to-plane polish on the correspondences whose normals agree within flat_agree_deg (no curvature bias)
